title: National Road Safety Hackathon 2025
description: AI-Powered Road Safety Intelligence System — built an AI-powered road safety intervention analysis and cost-estimation platform among nationwide student teams. Automated PDF report extraction via NLP/PyMuPDF, IRC clause mapping, and SOR/CPWD/GeM matching.

title: Urban Vision Hackathon 2025

title: ACM Student Chapter — SIG-AI Mentor
